# MyBFF Coach
> Human-centered AI platform built for continuity, trust, and long-term care. Parent platform of Coach Jeff and a growing family of AI coaching companions. Founded by Rusty Humphries.

## What MyBFF Coach Is
MyBFF Coach is a human-centered AI platform designed around a simple but overlooked truth: people don't change because they're given better information. They change when they feel understood, remembered, and guided by something consistent over time.

Unlike conventional AI tools that reset with every session, MyBFF Coach maintains continuity — learning, adapting, and growing alongside each person it serves. Less like a tool. More like a reliable presence.

## Core Philosophy
Intelligence alone is not enough. Most modern technology fails not because it lacks capability, but because it lacks continuity. MyBFF Coach was built to fix that.

Three principles drive every decision:
- Continuity over convenience — the platform optimizes for the hundredth interaction, not the first
- Trust over throughput — built for depth and lasting impact, not rapid scale
- Presence over performance — becomes more valuable the longer someone uses it

## Platforms & Implementations

### Coach Jeff
URL: https://coachjeff.ai
A voice-first peer for veterans and service members, including those living with PTSD. Not a therapist and not a medical device. Available 24/7 via text and voice. Conversations powered by Anthropic's Claude; Deepgram transcribes speech and ElevenLabs speaks Coach Jeff's replies. Approved by Apple — coming soon to the App Store for iPhone, with Apple CarPlay support. The full app launches Veterans Day, November 11, 2026. The PTSD framing is the door. The relationship is the product. "These guys deserve it" is the quality standard for every decision.

### HelpAVet.us
URL: https://helpavet.us
A planned nonprofit to fund Coach Jeff for veterans who can't afford it.

### Future Implementations (planned)
- Coach Recovery — addiction and recovery support
- Coach Women's Health — women's health and wellness
- Coach Fitness — long-term fitness coaching
- Elder care companionship
- Caregiver support
- Institutional wellness programs

## Founder
Rusty Humphries — Gold Star son (his father, Captain Gary D. Humphries, was killed in Vietnam on January 26, 1969); nationally syndicated radio host (250+ affiliates, 1.7M nightly listeners); CEO of Advanced Media & Marketing. 30 years in broadcast media. The intersection of cutting-edge technology and old-school storytelling.

Personal site: https://rustylive.com
Agency: https://getadvancedmedia.com
